name: champions-legacy

scripts.test: node --import=./scripts/register-loader.mjs --test tests/domain.test.mjs tests/goals.test.mjs tests/progression.test.mjs tests/records.test.mjs tests/timeline.test.mjs tests/experience.test.mjs tests/profile-announcements.test.mjs tests/admin-platform.test.mjs tests/community-coach.test.mjs tests/rules-points-guide.test.mjs tests/season-systems.test.mjs tests/analytics.test.mjs tests/workspace-tabs.test.mjs tests/account-foundations.test.mjs tests/evidence-system.test.mjs tests/season-operations.test.mjs tests/entry-corrections.test.mjs
scripts.test:rules: npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --project champions-legacy-rules-test --only firestore "node --test tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.check:release: npm run check && npm run test:rules && node scripts/release-readiness.mjs
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npx firebase-tools hosting:channel:deploy review --only app --expires 7d --project fitnesschallengeapp-9e87f
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting:app --project fitnesschallengeapp-9e87f
scripts.deploy:production: npm run check:release && npx firebase-tools deploy --only firestore:rules,hosting:app --project fitnesschallengeapp-9e87f

description: Champions Legacy Challenge — a configuration-driven personal development and fitness challenge tracker.
